mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.activity_id, a.activity_name, a.activity_desc, a.state, a.update_time, s.order_amounts_rate, s.dividend_cycle, s.settlement_strategy, s.dividend_method, s.dividend_role, s.dividend_user FROM activity a LEFT JOIN strategy s ON a.strategy_id = s.strategy_id where a.id=#{id}

select id, activity_id, activity_name, activity_desc, strategy_id, condition_type, condition_value, repeat_type, repeat_value, `state`, other_config,creator, create_time, update_time from activity where activity_id = #{req.activityId}
